Changes.LogName: Jodi: event answers and next-day topics

Entries.event_empty0: That's exactly it... I love him so much it hurts.$s
Entries.event_empty1: Something for myself...$s#$b#I wouldn't even know where to begin. But I'll think about it. Thank you.
Entries.event_empty2: ...$s#$b#*sniffle*... You're very good at this, you know that?$l
Entries.event_draw0: ...$s#$b#That's the kindest thing anyone has said to me in a long time.$l
Entries.event_draw1: Trying. Yes. I can hold on to that.$s
Entries.event_draw2: Maybe. I suppose I just worry. It's what I do.$s
Entries.event_fever0: Harvey. Yes. Okay.$s#$b#Thank you for being clear when I couldn't be.
Entries.event_fever1: Water, rest. Yes. I can do that.$s#$b#Thank you.
Entries.event_fever2: Just a fever... You're right, I'm overreacting. I always do.$s
Entries.event_river1: Both at once. Yes. That's exactly how it feels.$l
Entries.JodiEmptyNest: I folded Sam's jacket and put it on the shelf where I can see it.$s#$b#I think I needed someone to see me cry about it. Thank you.$l
Entries.JodiDrawing: I told Vincent it's okay to miss his dad. He cried, then I cried, then we ate cookies.$h#$b#I'm still not sure I said the right thing. But I said something.
Entries.JodiFever: Vincent's fever broke. Harvey says he'll be fine in a few days.$h#$b#I'll probably panic again next time. But it helped that I wasn't alone.$s
Entries.JodiRiver: I've been thinking about what I said at the lake.$l#$b#I'm going to stop apologizing for being happy. Starting soon. Maybe tomorrow.$h
